index for exact source-family generating series. It does not assert LC. -/
namespace MathGKM.Markov
noncomputable section
open Polynomial

def columnSeries3af (i : ℕ) : PowerSeries (Polynomial ℤ) :=
  PowerSeries.mk (fun q => (twoFamily3af q).coeff i)

theorem two_initial3af : twoFamily3af 1=
    (S^2-2*V)*twoFamily3af 0-V*(V+1)-4*U*V := by
  norm_num [twoFamily3af,fib_zero6,fib_one6,fib_two6,S]
  ring

theorem two_initial_column3af (i : ℕ) :
    (twoFamily3af 1).coeff (i+2)=
      (1+X^2)*(twoFamily3af 0).coeff (i+2)+
      2*(X+1)*(twoFamily3af 0).coeff (i+1)+
      (twoFamily3af 0).coeff i := by
  rw [two_initial3af]
  have hs : S^2-2*V=U^2+C (2*(X+1))*U+C (1+X^2) := by
    simp only [S,U,V,map_mul,map_add,map_ofNat,map_one,map_pow]; ring
  have he : 4*U*V=C (4*X)*U := by
    simp only [U,V,map_mul,map_ofNat]; ring
  rw [hs,he]
  simp only [add_mul,mul_assoc,Polynomial.coeff_add,Polynomial.coeff_sub,
    U,V,← map_mul,← map_add,map_one,Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
    Polynomial.coeff_X_pow_mul,show i+2=i+1+1 by omega,
    Polynomial.coeff_X_mul,Polynomial.coeff_X,Polynomial.coeff_C,Polynomial.coeff_one,
    show ¬1=i+1+1 by omega,show i+1+1≠0 by omega,if_false,mul_zero,sub_zero]
  ring

theorem column_series_recurrence3af (i : ℕ) :
    ((1-PowerSeries.X)*(1-PowerSeries.C (X^2)*PowerSeries.X))*columnSeries3af (i+2)=
      PowerSeries.C ((twoFamily3af 0).coeff (i+2))+
      PowerSeries.X*(PowerSeries.C (2*(X+1))*columnSeries3af (i+1)+columnSeries3af i) := by
  have he : ((1-PowerSeries.X)*(1-PowerSeries.C (X^2)*PowerSeries.X) :
      PowerSeries (Polynomial ℤ))=1-PowerSeries.C (1+X^2)*PowerSeries.X+
      PowerSeries.C (X^2)*PowerSeries.X^2 := by
    simp only [map_add,map_one]; ring
  rw [he]
  apply PowerSeries.ext
  intro q
  simp only [add_mul,sub_mul,one_mul,mul_assoc,map_add,map_sub,
    PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]
  rcases q with _ | (_ | q)
  · simp [columnSeries3af,PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul']
  · simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul,PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
      show ¬2≤1 by omega,if_false,PowerSeries.coeff_C,show 1≠0 by omega,
      mul_zero,add_zero,zero_add,map_add,PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,columnSeries3af,
      PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    linear_combination two_initial_column3af i
  · simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul,PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
      show 2≤q+1+1 by omega,if_true,show q+1+1-2=q by omega,
      PowerSeries.coeff_C,show q+1+1≠0 by omega,if_false,zero_add,
      map_add,PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,columnSeries3af,PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    linear_combination two_polynomial_coefficient3af q i

#print axioms column_series_recurrence3af
end

# Exact numerator-two column recursion

Machine-authored request 3af43e697b6b47c785aedffc7f2fb037. No root closure.
Write F_n for the inherited source Fibonacci numerator, S=u+v+1, and
P_q=F_(q+1)^2+v F_q^2. For q>=1 this is exactly the source at 2/(2q+1).
P_0=(u+v)^2+v is an auxiliary initial polynomial, not a source witness.

The checked Cassini identity gives the inhomogeneous recurrence

    P_(q+2)=(S^2-2v)P_(q+1)-v^2 P_q-4u v^(q+2).

Eliminating its geometric forcing gives

    P_(q+3)=(S^2-v)P_(q+2)-v(S^2-v)P_(q+1)+v^3 P_q.

MarkovFamilyRecurrence3af and MarkovFamilyEquation3af prove these for every q.
For H(t)=sum P_q t^q, MarkovGenerating3af proves D H=N exactly in formal
power series, with D=(1-vt)((1-t)(1-v^2 t)-u(u+2v+2)t), and

    N=(1-vt)(u^2+2uv+v(1+v)(1-t))-4uvt.

The Lean numerator is stated using P_0,P_1,P_2; the displayed simplification
is the elementary expansion of those seeds, also checked by the experiment.
There is no analytic convergence hypothesis.

Let C_i(q)=[u^i]P_q and G_i(t)=sum C_i(q)t^q. For every i>=0,
MarkovColumnSeries3af proves

    (1-t)(1-v^2t)G_(i+2) = C_(i+2)(0)+t(2(v+1)G_(i+1)+G_i).

Thus the arbitrary-column problem has a uniform positive recurrence, rather
than needing a separate denominator-cleared jet calculation for each column.
MarkovPositiveKernel3af supplies its inverse kernel

    K=1/((1-t)(1-v^2t)), [t^q]K=sum_(r=0)^q v^(2r).

It proves the exact recursion G_(i+2)=K times the RHS. Kernel coefficients
are nonnegative; their gaps matter. The q=1 slice is 1+v^2 and fails adjacent
LC. It is not legitimate to treat K as the inherited Pascal smoothing kernel.

Subtracting neighboring q-columns gives

    C_i(q+2)-C_i(q+1)
      =v^2(C_i(q+1)-C_i(q))+2(v+1)C_(i-1)(q+1)+C_(i-2)(q+1), i>=2.

The initial difference has the same positive expression with q=0 and with
v^2 C_i(0) as its first term. Source coefficient nonnegativity therefore
proves C_i(q+1)>=C_i(q) coefficientwise, for all i>=2, all q and all j.
MarkovColumnMonotone3af proves this. MarkovSourceReduction3af connects the
comparison to an actual next path with denominator b+2, and proves the exact
root equivalence: all q>=1 numerator-two GlobalLC inequalities, AND all source
paths with a>=3. Neither conjunct has been proved.

increments themselves. They did find synchronization failures on actual source
families: at q=1,i=2,j=1 the source triple is [1,5,6] and the increment triple

synchronization. These rule out that straightforward summation proof, not the
source conjecture. Evidence: source-column-strategies.json. Increment LC
remains an unproved auxiliary conjecture and does not entail source LC alone.

A further algebraic expansion of H, not formalized as a coefficient formula

The exact pinned Conjecture63 remains unresolved.

relations. It does not separately name Nat.div: those relations characterize
the usual quotient and remainder. The map to the literal real ramp polynomial
is blockH_ramp_map274. Together they discharge the equality premise of the

The proof uses the actual word-pair recursion to identify a source word with
adjacent run blocks A^n B and A^(n+1) B. Its number of blocks is a and number

propagates the cleared block identity. The source trace and determinant
identities then give

## Checked inequality component

MarkovVerticalRamp025 proves nonnegativity, interval support and CrossLC of
the zero-extended coefficient sequence, for every real a>=3, r>=0 and natural
q>=1. In particular the proof does not require a denominator bound or r<a.
The interior ramp gaps are 16a^2. The two terminal comparisons are proved
algebraically, with q=1 and the possible zero initial coefficient retained.

MarkovVerticalPoly025 identifies this sequence with the literal polynomial
coefficients, transports through arbitrary powers of (1+v) and monomial shifts,
and proves vertical_one_of_formula025. Its equality premise is explicit and
UNPROVED for general source paths. It must not be counted as an unconditional
first-interior vertical inequality. Numerators a=1,2 are also outside that
particular residual theorem.

## Source-specific bridge and proposed assembly

For a raw matrix M, let K(M)=(v+1)[u]M_11+[u]M_21. At u=0 each nonempty
word ending in B has M_21=M_22=0 and M_11=(v+1)M_12. The checked multiplication
identity is

    K(MN) = [u^0]N_11 K(M) + [u^0]M_11 K(N).

For the actual source matrix, tr(M)=(u+v+1)P and det(M)=u^a v^b.
When a>=2 its first determinant coefficient vanishes. The checked theorem
source_vertical_jet025 gives

    (v+1)^2 [u]P = K(M)-[u^0]M_11.

This is an unconditional exact source/raw bridge, not the candidate Q formula.

MarkovVerticalBlocks025 proves that every source path is either entirely left
steps, or its actual matrix is a word in two blocks A^n B and A^(n+1) B,
with both block types present. It follows by splitting at the first right
step and commuting block substitution with the actual Farey pair recursion.
The block list retains the source order. No claim that arbitrary block words
are source words is used.

The following assembly is a mathematical derivation still needing its final
Lean statement and proof. For a single block A^n B the explicit jet is

    [u]M_21 = v^(n+2) + 2v sum_(k=0)^n v^k,
    K(M) = 4 sum_(k=0)^n k v^k
           +3(n+1)v^(n+1)+(n+2)v^(n+2).

MarkovVerticalRun025 formalizes these identities; consult the validation
manifest for its actual acceptance status. Put q=n+1 for the two block types.
Define the linear-in-(a,b) expression

    H(a,b,q)=4 sum_(k<q)(b-aq+ak)v^k +3b v^q +(a+b)v^(q+1).

The short block has K=H(1,q,q); the long block has K=v H(1,q+1,q).
Their constant upper-left entries are respectively v^q(v+1) and
v^(q+1)(v+1). The cleared multiplication identity therefore propagates

    v^q(v+1) K(M) = [u^0]M_11 H(a,b,q).

Combining with the source jet and [u^0]M_11=v^b(v+1)^a gives

    v^q(v+1)^3 [u]P = v^b(v+1)^a (H-v^q(v+1)).

Since H-v^q(v+1)=Q, cancellation gives the candidate when a>=3.
The final formal assembly must identify block counts with a,b, identify
q=floor(b/a), justify every exponent/cancellation, and handle a=1,2 separately.
These obligations are not hidden assumptions in any accepted theorem.

The published [Evans–Veselov–Winn source](https://armj.math.stonybrook.edu/Articles/250708-Winn/index.html)

axiom. No historical novelty claim is made for the candidate formula.

The other vertical lines, general horizontal rows and remaining diagonal
slices still need universal inequalities. No combination of the work in this
